parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part includes one blade and its attached handle, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides a grip for the user to apply force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the screw joint to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and handle, also made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the other half of the cutting pair, working in conjunction with the first blade handle set to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint in the opposite direction to the first blade handle set.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at the pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blades together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the blades around it.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A secondary screw or nut component that secures the main pivot screw in place.
parts.Functional_description: It ensures the pivot screw remains tight and maintains the correct tension between the blades.
parts.Movement_description: It does not move during normal operation but can be adjusted for maintenance.
